title: Require Native Service oRPC Composition
forbids: implement outside impl.ts; more than one implement call; root contract or the exact official Effect extension in base.ts; an impl.ts without one unconfigured implementer and a configured service made only from native .use calls rooted at impl; a module descending through a non-matching configured branch; a module-root router without one bare plain operation tree; router implementation in a module tree or anywhere outside root router.ts; more than one root impl.router call; or root router implementation through a configured stage
why: One visible native lineage separates context declaration, optional context-middleware authorship, contract implementation, configured handler authorship, plain module composition, and aggregate router implementation through the unconfigured oRPC 2 root stage while preserving once-only middleware execution.
remediate: Keep base.ts declaration-only, adding the native base author only when context-authored middleware consumes it. In impl.ts create impl = implement(contract).$context<Context>() exactly once and derive service through zero or more native .use(...) calls rooted at impl. Derive each module from service.<matchingModule>, export a bare plain operation tree from its module-root router.ts, and implement the aggregate router exactly once in root router.ts through impl.router(...).
message: Service composition must preserve one native oRPC implementation lineage.
